review_description: Getting quotes was a challenge to say the leastThen comparing the quotes- price, panels and inverters- crazyLucky my son took a look and put them in groups, from there we narrowed it down to 4 which had similar products and prices,. Then asked for the same products and then there was 2 to choose from and went with local supplier.Weather wasn’t great but managed to complete installation on the day.The men were all polite and cleaned up after themselves.Unfortunately my wifi wasn’t strong enough to pickup the inverter which I’m in the process of an upgrade..Very happy with the service.
Quick and easy to deal with, fair price (not the cheapest) amazing customer service
